notes:
GeekClaw v5.0.27 - Frontend UI for New Channels (WhatsApp / LINE / Email)

New channel-config UI (5.0.27)
- WhatsAppConfigForm: Phone Number ID + Access Token + Verify Token + App Secret
  fields with Meta Cloud API quickstart link. HMAC-SHA256 signature verification
  wired into the backend plugin.
- LineConfigForm: Channel ID + Channel Access Token + Channel Secret fields with
  LINE Messaging API docs link. HMAC base64 X-Line-Signature verification wired in.
- EmailConfigForm: From Address + App Password + (optional) IMAP/SMTP Host/Port.
  Gmail / Outlook / QQ / 163 / 126 hosts are auto-resolved when blank. SMTP
  send is wired and fully active; IMAP polling is a stub pending 5.0.27.1.
- All three appear in the channel-settings platform list (12 → 15 platforms)
  alongside WeCom, Telegram, Discord, etc.

i18n
- zh-CN and en-US settings.json updated with three new sections:
  `whatsapp` (15 keys), `line` (13 keys), `email` (17 keys).
- `channels` table gains `whatsappTitle` / `lineTitle` / `emailTitle`.

Compatibility
- Backend plugin binaries from 5.0.26 unchanged. PluginType / PluginCredentials
  schema unchanged.
- 5.0.26 users on the auto-update channel are pulled to 5.0.27 to get the UI.
